_about: Case-by-case killer rules for killers.py, mostly boss maps. 'killer' = who a death on this map is blamed on; 'probably': true marks it a guess ('Died, probably to X'); 'ignore' = mobs never blamed on this map. Maps with one mob species or one clearly stronger mob need no entry (killers.py works those out from map_mobs.json). Map names as in maps_classic.json. Edit freely; the player's copy in the data folder wins.
